definitions.gloss: again, once more, a second time
definitions.explanation: Indicates something happening for another time after a previous occurrence.

examples.japanese: {再|ふたた}び{会|あ}える{日|ひ}を{楽|たの}しみにしています。
examples.english: I'm looking forward to the day we can meet again.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{再|ふたた}び{チャンピオン}になった。
{同|おな}じ{過|あやま}ちを{再|ふたた}び{繰|く}り{返|かえ}さないでください。
examples.english: Please don't repeat the same mistake again.

notes:
USAGE: {再|ふたた}び is a formal or literary way to say "again." It emphasizes that something is happening for a second time after a break or interval.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{再|ふたた}び〜する (to do ~ again)
・{二度|にど}と〜ない...{再|ふたた}び (never again... once more)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・また - again (casual, everyday)
・もう{一度|いちど} - one more time (neutral)
・{再|さい}び/{再度|さいど} - again (formal)
